name: Malland Hing Halls
description: Close to the city of Stonelair stands a monolith alongside an entrance to a vast dungeon. It takes at least a day’s journey on foot to traverse it. These are the Malland King Halls. Unfortunately, it is protected by a magic barrier that is impossible to break, even using the most powerful known spells. After a long study, the dwarf sages believe they need someone with the descendency of Malrok to cross the barrier; they are now searching for a courageous individual with the Ancient Blood. They offer rewards for any information leading to such an individual. The scholars suggest this place is both a prison and a treasure hall. Malrok kept powerful extraplanar beings and other dangerous entities locked away, beings he could not destroy. However, it contains artifacts from his Age that Malrok considered powerful enough to keep hidden.
